meta.title: Stable Diffusion — LoRA fine-tuning
meta.description: Teaches Stable Diffusion 1.5 a new subject or style from a few dozen images: low-rank adapters on the UNet's attention layers train while the base model stays frozen. Each image is captioned 'a photo of {class}' from its folder. Replace the demo shapes with your own image folder. Needs the generative extra, a 4.3 GB download on first run and a GPU (or Apple silicon); set weights to none to check the design offline.
